summary: Thousands evacuated near Athens as wildfires continued; Agios Stefanos ordered 10,000 residents onto the highway. Deputy mayor Panayiotis Bitakos urged residents to follow police, saying "It is too late now," and spokesman Ioannis Kapakis warned winds worsened conditions. Athens Prefect Yannis Sgouras said about 120 square kilometres burned; 83 major fires were reported, with no casualties yet.
